metadata.description: Recent Indian regulatory updates and notifications

updates.title: Mandatory E-Invoice for Businesses with Turnover Above Rs.5 Crore
updates.summary: E-invoicing mandate extended to businesses with aggregate turnover exceeding Rs.5 crore. All B2B invoices must be reported to Invoice Registration Portal (IRP) and carry valid IRN and QR code. Non-compliant invoices will be treated as invalid for ITC purposes.
updates.action_required: Update billing systems to integrate with IRP API; validate all B2B invoices carry IRN

updates.title: DPDP Act Rules Notified - Consent Manager Registration Opens
updates.summary: Final rules under Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 notified. Consent Managers must register with Data Protection Board. Data Fiduciaries must implement verifiable consent mechanisms within 6 months. Penalty framework operationalized.
updates.action_required: Register as Consent Manager if applicable; implement consent collection; appoint DPO; conduct DPIA

updates.title: Enhanced ESG Disclosure Requirements for Top 1000 Listed Companies
updates.summary: SEBI mandates BRSR Core framework reporting for top 1000 listed companies by market capitalization. Reasonable assurance required on ESG metrics. Supply chain ESG reporting mandatory for top 250 companies.
updates.action_required: Implement ESG data collection; engage assurance provider; update annual report templates

updates.title: Revised Digital Lending Guidelines - Enhanced Borrower Protection
updates.summary: RBI issues revised guidelines mandating standardized Key Fact Statement (KFS) with APR disclosure, 3-day look-up period for all digital loans, and prohibition on automatic debit without explicit consent. LSPs cannot access mobile phone contacts or media files.
updates.action_required: Update KFS format; implement look-up period; review app permissions; modify auto-debit flows

updates.title: Mandatory XBRL Filing for All Companies with Turnover Above Rs.100 Crore
updates.summary: MCA extends mandatory XBRL financial statement filing to all companies with turnover exceeding Rs.100 crore or borrowings exceeding Rs.50 crore. Filing must use latest India Taxonomy 2026.
updates.action_required: Implement XBRL conversion tool; map chart of accounts to India Taxonomy; test filings

updates.title: EPF Wage Ceiling Revised to Rs.21,000 Per Month
updates.summary: EPFO revises wage ceiling for EPF contribution from Rs.15,000 to Rs.21,000 per month. All employees earning basic + DA up to Rs.21,000 are now mandatorily covered. Existing members above ceiling continue.
updates.action_required: Update payroll software; recalculate employer/employee contributions; issue revised salary structures

updates.title: GST Rate Rationalization - New 3-Slab Structure
updates.summary: GST Council approves rationalized rate structure: 5%, 12%, 18% (merging 12% and 18% for select items). Multiple items reclassified. New rate card effective from next quarter. Input tax credit mechanism simplified.
updates.action_required: Update HSN-rate mapping in ERP; revise price lists; communicate to customers; train accounts team

updates.title: T+1 Settlement Extended - T+0 Optional Settlement Introduced
updates.summary: SEBI introduces optional T+0 (instant) settlement for equity trades alongside mandatory T+1. Brokers must offer choice to investors. Additional margins applicable for T+0 trades.
updates.action_required: Update trading systems; modify client agreements; implement T+0 margin calculations

updates.title: New Tax Regime as Default - Updated TDS Rates for FY 2026-27
updates.summary: New tax regime with revised slabs is now default for all assessees. Employees must actively opt for old regime with employer. Updated TDS rates on salary, rent, professional fees, and contractual payments.
updates.action_required: Update payroll for new slabs; collect employee regime choice; revise TDS computation logic

updates.title: UPI Transaction Limit Increased to Rs.5 Lakh for Select Categories
updates.summary: RBI enhances UPI per-transaction limit to Rs.5 lakh for tax payments, education fees, healthcare, and capital markets. Standard P2P/P2M limit remains Rs.1 lakh. Per-day limits also revised upward.
updates.action_required: Update payment gateway limits; inform merchants; modify transaction validation rules

updates.title: Beneficial Ownership Reporting - Form BEN-2 Made Quarterly
updates.summary: MCA mandates quarterly filing of Form BEN-2 (declaration of significant beneficial ownership) for all companies. Threshold reduced to 10% holding. Non-compliance triggers freezing of shares.
updates.action_required: Collect BEN-1 from all shareholders; file BEN-2 quarterly; update beneficial owner register

updates.title: Mandatory Group Health Insurance for All Registered Companies
updates.summary: IRDAI in consultation with MCA mandates minimum group health insurance of Rs.5 lakh sum insured per employee for all companies with 50+ employees. Must include pre-existing diseases from day one.
updates.action_required: Procure group health policy; update HR policy; inform employees; budget additional cost
